00_README.B: The living home for every Kayan product — what it is, who it is for, what it costs to build, and what each dollar buys.
35 products · 8 families · 144 verified skills · 12 stakeholder targets · 13 launch roles · KAY-CLT-006-ENGINE

A single, living engine for Kayan's productised services — 35 products across 8 families, from a $280 voice-over to a $5,500 custom platform. It maps every product to the segments and pain points it solves, states value-for-money plainly, and gives staff a place to propose new products. It is the operating brain behind the client-facing Ready Products Catalogue.

A Brand & Creative · B Web, Apps & Technology · C Marketing & Growth · D Content, Writing & Translation · E Research, Data & Evaluation · F Finance, Admin & Support · G Packages for New Businesses · H Enterprise & Hospitality Suites. Each family is colour-coded across the workbook and the catalogue.

01 Product Master · 02 Segments & Pain Points · 03 Economics · 04 Bundles & Journeys · 05 Add-ons & Rush · 06 Ideas Bank · 07 Comparables · 08 Launch Roadmap · 09 Tiers · 10 Specializations (full taxonomy) · 11 Stakeholders & Targeting · 12 Launch Roles, KPIs & Tasks.

Fixed scope. Fixed price in USD. A named delivery day. A managed pod of verified talent. Three-layer QA. One free revision (extra at 20%). A 5-business-day acceptance window. 100% funded into escrow before any work begins — the founding rule, no exceptions. Kayan keeps a 20% net fee; talent receives 80%; a 2% holdback is kept 30 days.

Prices are anchored in USD and held firm. Payment in YER converts at the actual Aden market rate on the day (≈1,535 in May 2026), against the dated rate table — never a notional rate. Cost-to-build is a conservative estimate of talent payout at regional rates (Egypt entry $8–12/hr, experienced $18–25/hr); a planning assumption, refined with real pod data.

Expanded from 8 to 35 products: added mobile apps, custom platforms, IT/DevOps care, AI automation, bookkeeping, financial modelling, virtual assistant, customer-service desk, SEO, paid ads, voice-over; the tiered Startup-in-a-Box for new companies; and enterprise suites for big restaurants, larger hotels, and businessmen. Drawn from the Micro-Specialization Taxonomy, the earlier Offer Catalog (KAY-MKT-001), and live market research.
